_comment: Tool choice on the thirteen tools a host is actually shown by default (SUDOR_SCOPE unset). evals/golden.json tests the full list; this tests what Alexa+ sees, including about_me, which carries the cooling, the heating, living alone and the check-in hour and has no counterpart in the full list. Run with: npm run eval -- --core. Written October 2026; not yet run against a model. Phone calls, and anything that needs the add-on to speak first, are outside it: an add-on can do neither.
